title: Thioether-based novel transition metal complexes: Synthesis, DNA interaction, in vitro biological assay, DFT calculations, and molecular docking studies.
authors: Singh, Anmol; Barman, Pranjit; Gogoi, Himadri Priya
one_liner_zh: 该文合成新型过渡金属配合物并研究其与CT-DNA的嵌入结合及生物活性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子金属配合物而非TF-DNA体系，方法以DFT和常规对接为主，与课题核心关联有限。
abstract: A novel Schiff base ligand 2-(((2-(benzylthio)phenyl)imino)methyl)-4-chlorophenol and its cobalt, nickel, copper, and zinc metal complexes were prepared. Using B3LYP/6-31++G(d,p) method with LanL2DZ as basis set, the molecular structure of metal complexes has been optimized, and their parameters have been explored. The distorted octahedral geometries have been observed in cobalt, nickel, and copper complexes. In contrast, zinc complex exhibited distorted tetrahedral geometry indicating the coordination of metal ions with ligands through ONS binding sites, which are confirmed by various spectroscopic techniques, magnetic measurements, molar conductivity, elemental analysis, and DFT studies. The intercalative binding mode between CT-DNA and synthesized metal complexes has been determined by absorption and fluorescence spectroscopy. The binding constant values of metal complexes found to be varied from 5.28 x 10(3) M(-1) to 9.18 x 10(4) M(-1). Furthermore, several methods have been used to scrutinize the bioactivities, such as in vitro anti-diabetic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. From the obtained results, it can be concluded that zinc metal complex exhibited excellent anti-inflammatory and anti-diabetic activity compared to others. However, the copper complex has good antioxidant property. Besides deducing the prospective binding energies of inhibitors, molecular docking simulations have also been conducted utilizing the enzyme structures of B-DNA, 6-COX, alpha-amylase, and alpha-glucosidase.
abstract_zh: 制备了一种新型席夫碱配体2-(((2-(苄硫基)苯基)亚氨基)甲基)-4-氯苯酚及其钴、镍、铜和锌金属配合物。采用B3LYP/6-31++G(d,p)方法，以LanL2DZ为基组，对金属配合物的分子结构进行了优化，并探讨了其参数。在钴、镍和铜配合物中观察到畸变八面体几何构型。相比之下，锌配合物表现出畸变四面体几何构型，表明金属离子通过ONS结合位点与配体配位，这已通过各种光谱技术、磁测量、摩尔电导率、元素分析和DFT研究得到证实。通过吸收和荧光光谱确定了CT-DNA与合成的金属配合物之间的嵌入结合模式。金属配合物的结合常数在5.28 x 10(3) M(-1)至9.18 x 10(4) M(-1)之间变化。此外，采用多种方法审查了生物活性，如体外抗糖尿病、抗炎和抗氧化活性。从所得结果可以得出结论，与其他配合物相比，锌金属配合物表现出优异的抗炎和抗糖尿病活性。然而，铜配合物具有良好的抗氧化性能。除了推断抑制剂的潜在结合能外，还利用B-DNA、6-COX、α-淀粉酶和α-葡萄糖苷酶的酶结构进行了分子对接模拟。
